summary: Cloudflare adapters and Project Loro processing helpers.
context_hints: replica-ports.ts adapts Durable Object Storage and alarms to @clash/replica; durable ordering belongs to the portable engine.
storage.ts retains compatibility helpers and stable storage key definitions. Do not introduce foreign keys or runtime-specific types into @clash/replica.
Full snapshots remain the default until an offline-replica-aware shallow-history GC frontier exists.

key_files.replica-ports.ts: Durable Object event log, checkpoint, deduplication and scheduling ports.
key_files.storage.ts: Existing snapshot/update storage keys and migration-compatible helpers.
key_files.NodeProcessor.ts: Hosted caller glue to journal-first startGeneration; pending-task observation rechecked after awaits, journal-owned tasks excluded from legacy orphan recovery. Retired automatic description no-op is not scheduled.
key_files.TaskPolling.ts: Journal-first public status; never writes projections owned by the durable publisher. Historical tasks retain fallback with pendingTask recheck after awaits.
key_files.auth.ts: Project ownership plus API-token hash, finite JWT expiry or Better Auth session identity. Revalidates current D1 credential/project state before public connection commands and private delivery; evidence is safe for hibernation and contains no raw credential.
